LEMUR LEAP - a RetroStone VC game for Windows
(c) 2026 Pierre-Louis Boyer (8BCraft). Code MIT, art/music/sound CC BY-NC-SA 4.0: see LICENSE-lemurleap.txt.

A little ring-tailed lemur hops up a giant beanstalk, leaf after leaf, through the clouds and the sunset sky
into outer space. It bounces by itself: you steer it left and right (off one side, in on the other), stomp or
shoot the pests, grab the coins and the power-ups, and do not fall. Beat your record; coins buy hats and furs.

Run LemurLeap.exe. No installation needed (SDL2 is built in).

Controls                  Gamepad (SNES layout)      Keyboard
  steer                     D-pad Left / Right         arrows
  shoot a seed up           A (B, X, Y, Up too)        X (Z too)
  pause / resume            Start or Select            Enter, Backspace or Esc
  paused: back to title     B (the climb is kept)      Z
  title: the wardrobe       Left / Right               arrows
  title: buy the look       X, Y or Select             V, C or Backspace
  title: a new climb        B (when a climb is kept)   Z
The mouse is a finger: hold the left button on the left or right half to steer; click to shoot.

F11 or Alt+Enter: fullscreen. F12: screenshot. Close the window to quit.
Options: LemurLeap.exe --scale 4 --fullscreen
The record, the coins and the looks are saved in lemurleap.srm next to the exe.
